title: Describe a Color
description: Pick a color you can see and describe it to someone who has never seen it. You are not allowed to name any color.

rubric.ideal: It feels like the inside of a cold pipe, or biting foil, or the ten seconds before a thunderstorm lands.
It is the shade of the plastic chairs in an old waiting room, dull and slightly greasy under a flickering tube light.
I never say the name of the color; I describe its temperature, its texture, its weight and the sound it would make.

title: Finish the Abandoned Thing
description: Dig out a project you quit on and work it until it is done, or until 45 minutes runs out.

title: Scan an Art Book
description: Find a book with art in it and scan the barcode on the back. Then open it to a random page and look for one full minute.
